nodes.name: Sklearn Linear Model GLM Public API Shell
nodes.description: High-level Poisson/Gamma/Tweedie GLM estimator-selection, callback-boundary, and fitted-state atoms above SciPy L-BFGS-B and sklearn Newton optimizer boundaries.

nodes.name: glm_estimator_catalog
nodes.description: Expose public sklearn GLM regressor names useful for framework-level model selection.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns a fixed public estimator-name tuple and does not inspect data.

nodes.name: glm_estimator_distribution
nodes.description: Return the response distribution family represented by a public GLM estimator.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator_name: str, power: float | None = None) -> str
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom performs a constant-time branch over fixed estimator names.

nodes.name: glm_estimator_optimizer
nodes.description: Return the optimizer boundary selected by a public GLM estimator.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates the fixed solver label and returns it as boundary metadata.

nodes.name: glm_estimator_methods
nodes.description: Expose public methods useful for high-level GLM routing.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom returns the fixed fit, predict, and score tuple for public GLM regressors.

nodes.name: glm_fit_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public GLM fit payload for finite dense inputs without executing optimizer callbacks.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, X: object, y: object, sample_weight: object = None) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense fit inputs and target range, then packages references without optimizing.

nodes.name: glm_prediction_method_payload
nodes.description: Expose a public GLM prediction-like method payload without executing the estimator method.
nodes.type_signature: (estimator: object, method_name: str, X: object) -> dict[str, object]
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom validates dense prediction input and packages references, leaving prediction or scoring to sklearn.

nodes.name: glm_fit_return_self
nodes.description: Return the fitted public GLM estimator object from the public fit shell.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom checks fitted marker attributes and returns the same estimator object.

nodes.name: glm_fitted_state_summary
nodes.description: Expose fitted coefficient and optimizer metadata after deferred GLM optimizer execution.
nodes.complexity_reasoning: The atom exposes coefficient arrays and scalar fitted metadata already produced by sklearn fitting.

metadata.remediation_case: Case 2 public GLM estimator shells over SciPy L-BFGS-B and sklearn Newton optimizer boundaries
limitations: The internal fitted-state topology is obscured by external optimizer and sklearn Newton solver boundaries.
The shell models finite dense public API routing and compact fitted-state packaging, not optimizer convergence, validation execution, link callbacks, loss callbacks, or prediction/scoring internals.
